tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets that sit on bg, e.g. the step card in cooking mode. Pair with a line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: upcoming step dots, done-ingredient amount pills, image placeholders, unselected filter chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around surface cards and between list sections. Decorative only, not for control outlines.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines of interactive controls: unchecked checkboxes, outline buttons. Meets 3:1 against bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface. Also the fill of the main navigation button (Weiter).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: recipe meta, captions, completed items. 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink-filled buttons.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The accent: primary actions (Timer starten, Kochen starten), progress, checked states, active tab. Use once or twice per screen.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sage fills.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint: ingredient amount pills, selected filter chips, toggled icon buttons. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Time and highlights only: running timers, detected durations in step text, today in the week planner.

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Text and icons on butter.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (delete recipe, remove from plan). Never decorative.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Screen titles, recipe name on the detail screen.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Top-bar titles, card titles, the step counter.

styles.name: step
styles.sample: Karotten schräg in 1 cm dicke Scheiben schneiden.
styles.usage: Cooking-mode step text. Large enough to read from arm's length at the stove.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: List rows: ingredients, shopping items, search results.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text: descriptions, comments, empty states.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, timer labels, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above content, in sage.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the home indicator; large section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between major screen regions on tablets.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inline highlights in text (detected timers).

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Chips and small pills (36px tall).

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and 56px pill buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons, amount pills, step dots.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable. Kitchen hands are wet.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of primary pill buttons and the cooking-mode navigation.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Height of chips; their hit area still extends to 44px.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Step dots in cooking mode.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for something being dragged (a recipe moving across the week planner) and bottom sheets. Everything at rest uses borders.
